title: QT's Curated
body:
A modpack built for a currated vanilla experience on mulitplayer servers with the goal of being purely client sided. (but is not strictly vanilla in features)

! THIS PACK CONTAINS MOUSE TWEAKS ! You can remove the mod with no issue if you dont like it. It changes the way shift clicking and dragging items to distrbute items/move them works. It can be disorienting/annoying to some people.

It also contains the regular version of Xaero's maps (as opposed the fairplay/pvp version) which may be banned for advantage in some servers (check your server before hand)

includes:
- Render Optimization (sodium)
- A few basic shaders
- Mini/world map (Xaeros)
- Client sort (middle click chests to sort them)
- Bundle inventory gui
- Female Gender Mod
- Mouse tweaks
- No chat reports
- Jade (tells you what your looking at)
